items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: So Metcalf was up there, he had a band, he had a crown on his head. And Metcalf, he knew Louis Armstrong so he took the crown off. "He was my buddy."

ctx.x: Rex Stewart, yeah. Well, see, Rex Stewart -- yeah, Rex Stewart was playing a lot of horn. He was playing a lot of horn. He was playing another thing and he was partners. So what happened, Louis Armstrong had went back to Chicago and come up to the Savoy Ballroom for about three nights. So Metcalf was up there, he had a band, he had a crown on his head. And Metcalf, he knew Louis Armstrong so he took the crown off. "He was my buddy."

So then, the first set, we took it off and that was good. And the second night, Rex took off from his job, because guys would take off to come and get you. He took off from his job and he come up to the Savoy Ballroom and got just as many hands as Louis got. Everybody said, man, Rex got it. Rex was all right, yeah.
